data.name: SOLUM
data.detailed_description:
SOLUM is a sandbox factory-builder set on drifting floating islands orbiting a collapsed star. Harvest Sol and tame its energy, and stitch a working ecosystem together before the Island-Network tears itself apart.

Design modular production lines, automate everything.
Every decision pushes the system toward stability… or a beautiful, catastrophic chain reaction.

Build. Automate. Survive the pull.

  • Floating-island factory
    Expand from a single rock to a Island-Network. Claim new islands for space and more Sol deposits, then hold them together with infrastructure.

  • Resource loops with consequence
    Convert Sol and Lum into advanced components. Production creates Lost Sol you’ll have to manage.

  • Logistics that scale
    Relays for local throughput, burst transmitters for island-to-island shipping. Balance cost, reliability, and timing to keep lines saturated.

  • Power & stability
    Spin up Sol Extractors and maintain island integrity under increasing load. Push too hard and you’ll trigger accelarated decent and structural decay.

  • Research & progression
    Unlock new machines, better routing, smarter control, and tools to reshape islands into production hubs.

  • A living sandbox
    Pause, plan, and iterate. Build for elegance or brute-force capacity; the simulation doesn’t care how pretty it is if it works.

Development Status

SOLUM is in active development and currently in closed testing.
The focus right now is core factory gameplay, logistics, and island management.
Additional systems, including combat-adjacent challenges and some special modes, are being explored and will be shared when they’re ready.

data.short_description: SOLUM is a floating-island factory sandbox. Extract Sol and automate production across an expanding Island-Network. Build networks, route goods, and keep your islands stable against the pull of a collapsed star.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (22H2) or Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-9600K / AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 (12 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 6700 XT — DX12, hardware ray tracing
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires SSD. UE5 Lumen with hardware ray tracing enabled. Performance and specs will change during development.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-12700K / AMD Ryzen 7 5800X or better
  • Memory: 32 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070 (12 GB) / AMD Radeon RX 7900 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Windows-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Target 1080p@60 with Lumen RT. NVMe SSD strongly recommended. Laptop dGPUs OK; integrated graphics not supported.
